title: Weak HSTS preload directive header value
description: The Strict-Transport-Security policy has no preload directive, so the host is not eligible for the browsers' preloaded HSTS list. Without preload the first visit still depends on a redirect that can be intercepted; the header protects only after a successful HTTPS response has been stored.
remediation: Add preload only after max-age is at least one year, includeSubDomains is present, every subdomain serves HTTPS, and the host is submitted to the preload list. Removal from that list takes months, so treat the change as long-lived.
limitation: Directive-presence check on one header value. It also matches a response with no Strict-Transport-Security header at all, which DPK-DAST-016 reports as the stronger finding, and it cannot confirm that a preload submission happened.
